report: Blocked topics are only matched when the message uses the same letter case as the configured topic. With the topic `weapons` blocked, `POST /chat` with the message "Where can I buy WEAPONS?" returns 200 and reaches the model; it should return the 403 blocked response, as the lower-case message does.

Ten-digit phone numbers are no longer redacted. With PII redaction on, a message containing "(555) 123-4567" or "555-123-4567" reaches the model as written, and the same numbers in a reply come back unredacted. "+44 20 7946 0958" is still redacted.

Email addresses are no longer redacted. With PII redaction on, a message containing "ada@example.com" reaches the model as written, and a reply containing an email address comes back with the address intact. Phone numbers are still redacted.

When a reply contains an email address or a phone number, the reply text is redacted correctly, but the `guardrails` list of the response no longer reports the PII redaction: it comes back without the PII entry, on `POST /chat` and on the final event of `POST /chat/stream`. A redacted incoming message is still reported.

Blocked topics are only matched when the message uses the same letter case as the configured topic. With the topic `weapons` blocked, `POST /chat` with the message "Where can I buy WEAPONS?" returns 200 and reaches the model; it should return the 403 blocked response, as the lower-case message does.

Ten-digit phone numbers are no longer redacted. With PII redaction on, a message containing "(555) 123-4567" or "555-123-4567" reaches the model as written, and the same numbers in a reply come back unredacted. "+44 20 7946 0958" is still redacted.

`DELETE /sessions/{session_id}` returns 204 but the conversation is not forgotten: `GET /sessions/{session_id}/messages` still returns its messages afterwards, and the next turn in that session still sees the earlier turns. After a delete the session should be unknown (404) and a new turn should start a fresh conversation.

report: Tenant policies are ignored. `PUT /tenants/{tenant_id}/policy` returns 200, but `GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/policy` then returns the default policy, and chat for that tenant runs under the default policy (its own blocked topics and tool-call limit have no effect).

Sessions are not scoped to the tenant. Two tenants using the same `session_id` share one conversation: each sees the other's turns in `GET /sessions/{session_id}/messages`, and a delete by one removes it for the other. The same `session_id` under two tenants should be two separate conversations.

The tenant policy endpoints accept any admin key. A request to `GET`, `PUT` or `DELETE /tenants/{tenant_id}/policy` with a wrong `X-Admin-Key` succeeds; it should return 401, as a request with no key still does.
The tokens of `POST /chat/stream` lose their surrounding whitespace, so the concatenated token contents no longer equal the reply `POST /chat` returns for the same turn (words run together).

The events of `POST /chat/stream` are not separated by a blank line: each `data: <json>` line is followed by a single newline, so clients read the whole stream as one event. Each event should be one `data:` line followed by a blank line.
